title: Scaling Optimal Classification Trees via Adaptive Feature and Sample Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2609.05826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dynamic programming for optimal classification trees becomes computationally expensive as the numbers of features and training samples increase. We develop a joint feature- and sample-space reduction framework based on STreeD. Weighted STreeD merges duplicate records created after projection onto a fixed candidate set into weighted representatives. This reduces sample-dependent computation without changing the fixed-candidate optimization problem. Adaptive STreeD repeatedly refines a bounded candidate set, retains features used by the incumbent tree, rebuilds the weighted representation, and solves the resulting reduced problems. Each certified Weighted STreeD solution is optimal for its current candidate set, while the outer feature search remains heuristic over the full feature space. translated_title: 通过自适应特征与样本缩减实现最优分类树的可扩展求解
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.05826v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：随着特征数量和训练样本数量的增加，用于求解最优分类树的动态规划方法的计算成本变得极为高昂。我们基于STreeD开发了一个联合特征空间与样本空间缩减框架。加权STreeD将在投影到固定候选特征集后产生的重复记录合并为带权重的代表记录，从而在不改变固定候选集优化问题的前提下减少依赖样本的计算量。自适应STreeD则反复细化一个有界的候选特征集，保留当前最优树所使用的特征，重建加权表示，并求解由此得到的缩减问题。每一个经过验证的加权STreeD解对于其当前候选集而言都是最优的，而外层的特征搜索在整个特征空间上则保持启发式策略。在五个数据集上的实验表明，加权STreeD相比标准STreeD实现了高达121.41倍的加速。自适应STreeD降低了运行时间……
tldr: 该论文提出基于STreeD的加权与自适应联合特征-样本缩减框架，通过合并重复样本记录并迭代细化候选特征集，在保证候选集内最优性的前提下将最优分类树的求解速度提升最高121倍以上。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a weighted and adaptive joint feature-sample reduction framework built on STreeD, which merges duplicate records and iteratively refines bounded candidate feature sets, accelerating optimal classification tree solving by up to 121.41x while preserving optimality within each candidate set.
